features.name: Write Village Statistics to Text File
features.description: After each successful save of slots 1 through 5, writes the save's local lifetime statistics to 'Village Statistics - Save N.txt' in the modified game folder. Later games retain the inherited per-save statistics block even where no Statistics screen is reachable; omitted stock bookkeeping is restored by exact gameplay hooks. The original save result is preserved, and text-export failure does not turn a successful game save into a failure.

patches.purpose: route the stock full-save call through a wrapper that exports statistics only after a successful primary-slot save
call the stock writer unchanged, preserve its Boolean result, and invoke the hash-verified statistics companion for slots 1-5
